related.title: HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段；HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統改以氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages; HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation centers on helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照小型BWR蒸汽邊界與氦熱路與蒸汽邊界，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以許可與建造階段為起點，設計一項能區分「小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段」與「氦熱傳、雙模組與共同汽輪機」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare small-bwr steam boundaries with helium/steam boundaries and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from licensing/build stages and propose an observation distinguishing small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages from helium heat transfer, twin modules and a shared turbine, including uncertainty.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages; AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture centers on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照小型BWR蒸汽邊界與壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

practiceEn: Compare small-bwr steam boundaries with pwr heat source/steam generators and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

related.title: ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦西方首座併網型小型模組化反應爐的施工：豎井開挖、鋼板複合模組與隔離冷凝器；ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構則以沒有再循環泵的沸水式機組：煙囪、重力注水與隔離冷凝器的定量檢核為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building the first grid-scale SMR in the West: shaft excavation, steel-plate composite modules and isolation condensers; ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture centres on A boiling-water reactor without recirculation pumps: quantitative checks of chimney, gravity injection and isolation condensers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「自然循環的驅動壓頭」的模型移到ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「隔離冷凝器的移熱比例」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Driving head of natural circulation" to ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The heat-removal share of the isolation condensers", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ESBWR 自然循環沸水架構的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ESBWR natural-circulation boiling-water architecture must be respecified.

related.title: 達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Darlington CANDU Refurbishment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦西方首座併網型小型模組化反應爐的施工：豎井開挖、鋼板複合模組與隔離冷凝器；達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程則以四部 CANDU 機組的十年翻新：全尺寸模型、支管減薄、學習曲線與實獲值管理為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building the first grid-scale SMR in the West: shaft excavation, steel-plate composite modules and isolation condensers; Darlington CANDU Refurbishment centres on A ten-year refurbishment of four CANDU units: a full-scale mock-up, feeder thinning, the learning curve and earned-value management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「自然循環的驅動壓頭」的模型移到達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「集體劑量與作業規劃」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Driving head of natural circulation" to Darlington CANDU Refurbishment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Collective dose and work planning", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；達靈頓 CANDU 機組翻新工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Darlington CANDU Refurbishment must be respecified.
